title: A two-minute tour
summary: Math as you would write it on paper, with units, plots, solving, matrices and exact answers.

title: A baseball and the air
summary: How far a thrown ball really goes: a differential equation with units, solved and plotted.

title: An active low-pass filter
summary: A Sallen–Key filter from its netlist: node voltages at any frequency, a Bode plot, and the −3 dB point.

title: Matching an antenna
summary: Two parts that match a 25 Ω antenna to a 50 Ω radio, designed by formula and checked on a Smith chart.

title: Ten thousand voltage dividers
summary: Worst case or Monte Carlo? Random parts, statistics and a histogram for a divider built from 5% resistors.

title: Measuring a washer in a noisy picture
summary: Image processing on a picture made by formula: noise, dead pixels, a median filter, edges, and an area measured to within a few pixels.

title: How cloudy is the Earth?
summary: A color photograph read from a web address, split into channels and hue, and sorted pixel by pixel into cloud, ocean and land.

title: How much does a bookshelf sag?
summary: Beam bending with units: the sag of a loaded shelf, plotted for two thicknesses, and the thickness root finds to keep it straight.

title: Heat loss through a wall
summary: Layers in series, temperatures through the wall in °C, and how much insulation pays: vectors, sums and units.

title: Orbits, from a satellite to a comet
summary: Kepler's laws: a solve block for the geostationary orbit, then Halley's Comet on a polar plot, with Kepler's equation solved by root.

title: Finding a hum in the noise
summary: An FFT picks two tones out of a signal buried in noise, then a filter in the frequency domain and ifft bring the clean signal back.

title: Exact answers: calculus and Laplace
summary: Symbolic derivatives, integrals, limits and series, then a spring and damper solved exactly with the Laplace transform and checked numerically.

title: Phasors and power factor
summary: A motor as a complex impedance: its current as a phasor, a capacitor to correct its power factor, and RLC ringing.

title: Fitting a cooling curve
summary: Coffee readings fitted with a line, an exponential and a model of our own, and when it will be cool enough to drink.

title: Ordering by the box
summary: A parts table of strings and numbers: looking parts up, rounding up to whole boxes, and writing the order as text.

title: A drumhead and Bessel functions
summary: A drumhead's modes from the zeros of Bessel functions, and Γ giving the volume of a ball in n dimensions.

title: The skin effect in a wire
summary: Alternating current crowds to the surface of a copper bar: Bessel functions of a complex argument give its spread and the resistance it costs.

title: A mortgage, month by month
summary: A 30-year loan: its payment, where each payment goes, what paying a little extra saves, and whether solar panels pay their way.

title: Shapes in three dimensions
summary: A torus, a helix and a sphere from CreateMesh and CreateSpace, coordinates converted between systems, and points spaced on a log scale.

title: Cleaning up a noisy signal
summary: Noisy readings smoothed three ways, an echo's delay found by correlation, wavelet compression, and a blurred picture.

title: A staircase in feet and inches
summary: Laying out a stair from a builder's tape: risers and treads in feet, inches and fractions, the stringer's angle in degrees and minutes, and the time to cut it.

title: How a building sways
summary: A three-storey frame's natural frequencies and mode shapes, from its stiffness and mass matrices with genvals and genvecs, and its stiffness checked with svd2.

title: Colour and sound, by the numbers
summary: A picture built from numbers, its hues turned with the hue, lightness and saturation model, and a chime written as a WAV file, as Mathcad writes them.

title: A circuit, a beam and a reaction
summary: Three kinds of differential equation: a driven RLC circuit with statespace, a loaded beam whose far end is fixed, by shooting with sbval, and a stiff reaction whose Jacobian comes from Jacob.

title: Heat in a rod and a plate
summary: Partial differential equations: a rod cooling from its ends, solved as written with Pdesolve, and a plate heated along one edge, by relaxation.

title: Fringes, an overshoot and a diode
summary: Integrals with names: light bending round an edge with the Fresnel integrals, the Gibbs overshoot with the sine integral, and a diode's current, exactly, with Lambert's W.

title: Repeatable trials, stopping rules and tracing
summary: Seed to repeat a random experiment exactly, until to stop a recurrence at a limit, and trace to follow a program step by step.

title: Hills in color
summary: Colour maps for surface and contour plots: a landscape in a map of its own, made with SaveColormap, and the same heights in viridis.
